CreateJob.description_en: Creates a job and runs it in a cluster. You can specify information such as the data source configuration, code source configuration, startup command, and compute resource configuration for each node of the job
CreateJob.description_zh: 创建一个任务到集群中运行。您可以指定数据源配置、代码源配置、启动命令以及任务运行的每个节点的计算资源配置等信息

CreateSignal.description_en: Sends a signal to the Pods of a specified job and retrieves the signal ID
CreateSignal.description_zh: 向指定作业的Pod发送信号并获取信号ID

CreateTensorboard.description_en: Creates a TensorBoard by using a job or specifying a data source configuration
CreateTensorboard.description_zh: 创建一个Tensorboard，可以通过一个任务或者指定数据源配置来创建

DeleteJob.description_en: Deletes a completed or stopped job
DeleteJob.description_zh: 删除一个运行结束（或者已停止）的任务

DeleteJobTemplate.description_en: Deletes a job template. You cannot delete a job template that is in use by a job
DeleteJobTemplate.description_zh: 删除没有使用的任务模板，如果模版已经被任务使用则不允许删除

GetDashboard.description_en: Retrieves the Dashboard URL for a DLC job, if available
GetDashboard.description_zh: 获取DLC任务的Dashboard URL（如果存在）

GetJob.description_en: Retrieves the detailed configuration and runtime information of a task
GetJob.description_zh: 获取一个任务的详细配置和运行时信息

GetJobEvents.description_en: Obtains the system events of a job
GetJobEvents.description_zh: 获取一个任务的系统事件

GetJobMetrics.description_en: Obtains the monitoring data of a job, including the CPU, GPU, and memory utilization, network, and disk read/write rate. ⚠️ Note: Except for pay-as-you-go tasks based on general-purpose computing resources, all task types are connected to CloudMonitor. Use the CloudMonitor API to call related monitoring. The overwritten features in the original API are no longer maintained. For more information, see \[Training monitoring and alerting]\(https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/pai/user-guide/training-monitoring-and-alerting)
GetJobMetrics.description_zh:
获取一个任务的监控数据，包括CPU、GPU、Memory的使用率、Network、Disk读写速率等。

⚠️注意：除基于通用计算资源的按量付费（后付费）任务外，其余任务类型均已对接云监控。相关监控调用请使用云监控接口，原接口中已被覆盖的功能将不再维护。更多信息，请参见训练监控与报警 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/pai/user-guide/training-monitoring-and-alerting)

GetJobSanityCheckResult.description_en: Obtains specified job sanity check result in a Deep Learning Containers (DLC) job
GetJobSanityCheckResult.description_zh: 获取DLC任务某次算力健康检测结果

GetJobTemplate.description_en: Retrieves the details of a job template

GetPodEvents.description_en: Obtains the system events of a specific node in a job to locate and troubleshoot issues
GetPodEvents.description_zh: 通过获取任务中特定节点的系统事件，来进行问题的定位与排查

GetPodLogs.description_en: Retrieves or downloads the log of a specific node in a job. The log is collected from stdout and stderr of the system and user scripts
GetPodLogs.description_zh: 获取（或者下载）任务某个节点的日志，日志来源于系统和用户脚本的stdout和stderr

GetRayDashboard.description_zh: 获取 Ray Dashboard 链接

GetRayHistoryServer.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specific RayHistoryServer

GetSignal.description_en: Queries the details of a specific signal in a specified job
GetSignal.description_zh: 查询指定作业下的特定信号的详细信息

GetTensorboard.description_en: Retrieves the details of a Tensorboard instance

GetTensorboardSharedUrl.description_en: Obtains the shareable link of a TensorBoard task. The link contains digital tokens. You can use a shareable link to access a TensorBoard task
GetTensorboardSharedUrl.description_zh: 获得Tensorboard的分享链接。该链接中包含数字令牌。使用该分享链接可以访问被分享的Tensorboard任务

GetToken.description_en: Retrieves a sharing token for a DLC job, which is used to view information about the shared task
GetToken.description_zh: 获取DLC任务的分享令牌（Token），用于查看分享任务的相关信息

GetWebTerminal.description_en: Provides methods and steps to obtain a HTTP link for accessing a container
GetWebTerminal.description_zh: 提供获取容器访问HTTP链接的方法和步骤

ListEcsSpecs.description_en: Queries the list of supported instance types
ListEcsSpecs.description_zh: 查询当前支持的机器资源配置列表

ListJobSanityCheckResults.description_en: Obtains the results of all sanity checks for a DLC job
ListJobSanityCheckResults.description_zh: 获取某个DLC任务所有算力健康检测的检测结果

ListJobTemplates.description_en: Lists job templates in a specified workspace. You can paginate, sort, and filter the results by creator, `TemplateId`, or `TemplateName`
ListJobTemplates.description_zh: 按工作空间列出任务模板，支持分页与排序；可按创建者、TemplateId、TemplateName 筛选

ListJobs.description_en: Retrieves a list of jobs with support for pagination, sorting, and conditional filtering
ListJobs.description_zh: 获取任务列表，支持分页、排序和按条件过滤

ListSignals.description_en: Queries all signal records of a specified job
ListSignals.description_zh: 查询指定作业的所有信号记录

ListTensorboards.description_en: Queries a list of created Tensorboard instances

SetJobTemplateDefaultVersion.description_en: Sets the default version of a job template

StopJob.description_zh: 停止一个正在运行的任务

TagResources.description_en: Creates and attaches tags to specified resources

UntagResources.description_en: Unbinds tags from a specified list of resources
UntagResources.description_zh: 为指定的资源列表统一解绑标签

UpdateJob.description_en: Updates the configuration of a job, such as modifying the priority of a queued job
UpdateJob.description_zh: 更新一个任务的配置信息，例如修改一个排队中任务的优先级
